Runs Omarchy's Quickshell desktop shell — its bar, notifier, launcher, OSD and lockscreen, as one supervised service.
In Omarchy 4.x the entire desktop shell is a single Quickshell QML tree shipped
by the omarchy package at /usr/share/omarchy/shell. There is no waybar, no
mako, no walker and no swayosd to install separately — those were the 3.x
stack. This candy installs Quickshell and supervises that tree directly.
Verifiable on the built image: the quickshell binary and the shell tree are
present; at deploy, the shell reaches a stable supervised RUNNING state
against the compositor's Wayland socket.

## Services

- `omarchy-shell`

## Acceptance plan

This candy's `plan:` — the runnable spec `charly check` executes against a live deployment. `check:` steps are idempotent probes; `run:` steps change state.

| Intent | Step |
|---|---|
| `check` | the Quickshell runtime is installed |
| `check` | the Omarchy shell QML tree this service runs is present |
| `agent-check` | with the compositor up, the Quickshell shell reaches a stable supervised RUNNING state and draws its bar into the captured desktop |
| `check` | service=omarchy-shell |
| `check` | command=supervisorctl status omarchy-shell shows a stable uptime |
